description: This Java source file defines the HybridClientRegistrationRepository class, which implements ClientRegistrationRepository to provide OAuth2 client registration details by fetching OAuth2Client data and converting it into Spring Security's ClientRegistration objects.

classes.name: HybridClientRegistrationRepository
